caption: Figure 10: The changes of a container packet forwarded by ONCache with the rewriting-based tunneling protocol. (a) The original packet from containers. (b) The masqueraded packet. (c) The restored packet.
subject: how a container packet's IP/MAC header fields are rewritten to host addresses on egress and restored on ingress

groups.why_chosen: The rewriting-based tunneling protocol substitutes traditional outer-header encapsulation with in-place rewriting of the container's own IP/MAC header fields to host addresses (plus a restore key) on egress, then rewrites them back to the original container addresses on ingress at the destination.
groups.what_to_learn: Three identical frames; the operation name rides the arrow between them; only the text inside the fixed coloured rows changes
